## Welcome

This website documents my BU AD688 cloud computing environment and reproducible data science setup.

The work was completed on an AWS Academy EC2 instance running Ubuntu. The environment includes Python, Java, PySpark, Git, GitHub SSH authentication, and Quarto.

## Environment Verification

The following Python code reports key components of the environment.

```{python}
import platform
import sys
from importlib.metadata import version

environment = {
    "Platform": "AWS EC2",
    "Operating system": platform.platform(),
    "Python version": sys.version.split()[0],
    "PySpark version": version("pyspark"),
    "Course": "BU AD688",
}

for component, value in environment.items():
    print(f"{component}: {value}")
```

## Reproducibility

Project configuration and code are version controlled with Git and published through GitHub Pages. Private API credentials are stored in a local `.env` file that is excluded from Git.
